mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBERSHIP_REGISTRATION ( email_id, membership_num, register_date, start_date, end_date, status ) VALUES ( #{memberEmail}, #{membershipNum}, CURDATE(), #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status} )

INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( email_id, membership_num, mr_num, payment_date, payment_price, payment_fee, method, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userEmail}, #{membershipNum}, #{mrNum}, NOW(), #{paymentPrice}, #{paymentFee}, #{method}, #{status}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT mr_num AS mrNum, member_num AS memberNum, membership_num AS membershipNum, register_date AS registerDate, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, status FROM MEMBERSHIP_REGISTRATION WHERE mr_num = #{mrNum}

SELECT payment_num AS paymentNum, user_num AS userNum, membership_num AS membershipNum, mr_num AS mrNum, payment_date AS paymentDate, payment_price AS paymentPrice, payment_fee AS paymentFee, method, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM PAYMENT WHERE payment_num = #{paymentNum}
SELECT membership_num AS membershipNum, gym_num AS gymNum, type, type_rep AS typeRep, price FROM MEMBERSHIP WHERE membership_num = #{membershipNum}

SELECT p.payment_num AS paymentNum, p.email_id AS userEmail, p.membership_num AS membershipNum, p.payment_price AS paymentPrice, p.method AS method, p.status AS status, p.reason AS reason, p.canceled_at AS canceledAt, u.name AS memberName, CONCAT( CASE WHEN m.type = 'pt' THEN 'PT ' WHEN m.type = 'day' THEN '1일 ' WHEN m.type = 'month' THEN '헬스장 ' ELSE '' END, m.type_rep, CASE WHEN m.type = 'pt' THEN '회권' WHEN m.type = 'month' THEN '개월 이용권' WHEN m.type = 'day' THEN '이용권' ELSE '' END ) AS membershipName FROM PAYMENT p JOIN USER u ON p.email_id = u.email_id JOIN MEMBERSHIP m ON p.membership_num = m.membership_num WHERE m.gym_num = #{gymId} AND p.status = '환불요청' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT p JOIN MEMBERSHIP m ON p.membership_num = m.membership_num WHERE m.gym_num = #{gymId} AND p.status = '환불요청'
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENT SET status = '환불완료' canceled_at = NOW() WHERE payment_num = #{paymentNum}
